blocks.title: What matters for businesses in the

items.title: Found by local customers
items.text: Service and trade businesses rely on being found nearby. Websites and Google campaigns are structured around the areas you actually serve.

items.title: Clear on cookies and data
items.text: Sites are built with UK data-protection and cookie-consent expectations in mind, and without tracking you do not need.

items.title: Less admin, faster replies
items.text: Enquiry forms, AI agents and dashboards are connected so every lead is answered, logged and followed up without manual copying.

blocks.title: Five services. Take one, or
blocks.lead: Every service is available on its own, with a custom quote. No forced bundles.

items.q: Do you work with businesses across the UK?
items.a: Yes. Keelbiz works remotely with businesses in London and across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, by video call and email.

items.q: Can you help a local service business get more enquiries?
items.a: Yes. A clear website, well-structured Google and Meta campaigns and fast replies to every enquiry are the usual starting points. We recommend a plan after a short discovery call.

items.q: Do I have to take more than one service?
items.a: No. Each service is available on its own. You can add others later if they would help.
Every project gets a custom quote after a short discovery call. Third-party costs such as ad spend, domains or software subscriptions are paid by you directly and are always shown separately.
